name: dre-search-client
description: Svelte client for the DRESearch Omeka S module — faceted search (research items + research projects + publications + podcasts + YouTube videos + people + research sections + organisations + genres + languages + locations + subjects & tags) backed by Typesense.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:tokens && npm run lint:version && npm run lint:schema && npm run lint:i18n && eslint src/svelte tests scripts playwright.config.ts && prettier --check "src/svelte/**/*.{ts,svelte}" "tests/frontend/**/*.ts" "tests/browser/**/*.ts" "*.{ts,json,md}"
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src/svelte tests scripts playwright.config.ts --fix && prettier --write "src/svelte/**/*.{ts,svelte}" "tests/frontend/**/*.ts" "tests/browser/**/*.ts" "*.{ts,json,md}"
